title: POD-RoPE: Rotary Position Encoding over Physical Observation Distributions for Embodied AI
abstract: arXiv:2610.33745v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Embodied perception requires positional representations that capture both physical geometry and the spatial and temporal extent of observations. We introduce POD-RoPE (Physical Observation Distribution RoPE), which represents token observation footprints as distributions over camera centers, viewing directions, and sampling times. Under independent sampling, expected rotations encode relative relationships between distributions; when each distribution collapses to a single address, the construction recovers pointwise RoPE. The same rotation statistics support Q/K matching and coherence-dependent V/O transformations, allowing observation geometry to guide both information selection and content aggregation. Per-token pre-aggregation avoids increasing sequence length or processing pairs of observation nodes. translated_title: POD-RoPE：面向具身智能的物理观测分布旋转位置编码
translated_abstract: 具身感知需要位置表示能够同时捕捉物理几何以及观测的空间与时间范围。我们提出了POD-RoPE（物理观测分布RoPE），它将token的观测足迹表示为相机中心、观察方向和采样时间上的分布。在独立采样条件下，期望旋转能够编码分布之间的相对关系；当每个分布坍缩为单一地址时，该构造退化为逐点的RoPE。相同的旋转统计量同时支持Q/K匹配以及依赖一致性的V/O变换，使观测几何能够同时指导信息选择和内容聚合。逐token的预聚合机制避免了增加序列长度或处理观测节点对。我们在四种机器人策略架构、仿真与真实世界操作任务以及互补的重构任务上对POD-RoPE进行了评估。
tldr: 提出POD-RoPE，一种将观测足迹表示为相机中心、观察方向和采样时间上的分布的旋转位置编码方法，在分布坍缩时可退化为标准RoPE，并利用观测几何同时指导信息选择与内容聚合，且不增加序列长度。
en_tdlr: POD-RoPE is a rotary position encoding that represents token observation footprints as distributions over camera centers, viewing directions, and sampling times—degenerating to standard RoPE when distributions collapse—and uses observation geometry to guide both information selection and content aggregation without increasing sequence length.
